title: Playstation®4 Title
description: Removes the Java Edition and adds the Playstation®4 instead (LEGACY4J REQUIRED)
body:
# **Playstation®4 Title**

**This Resource Pack changes the title from Java Edition to Playstation®4. You need the [Legacy4J](https://modrinth.com/mod/legacy4j) Mod to use this Resource Pack.**

### _____________________________________________________________________________________________


### 📝 Note:

**This Resource Pack does not work in Vanilla you need the Legacy4J Mod**
